newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front - July 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front - July 30.

text.p: The Washington Post included the following stories on its front page on July 30:
WASHINGTON - President Clinton and Republican leaders celebrated their five-year plan to balance the budget, lower some taxes and shore up federal health insurance programs.
WASHINGTON - Two Gaithersburg, Maryland women testified before a Senate panel Tuesday that they wrote illegal checks to the Democratic National Committee.
WASHINGTON - There are a wide range of benefits and costs that American taxpayers would see if the $94 billion tax cut deal announced by Congress and the White House becomes law.
WASHINGTON - Advocacy groups were surprised that Monday's budget deal includes significant increases in social spending.
KUALA LUMPUR, MALAYSIA - Asian and U.S. diplomats clashed publicly over human rights at a meeting normally devoted to celebrating their good relations.

MOSCOW - Wealthy industrialists backed Russian President Boris Yeltsin in his reelection bid last year, but now they are feuding bitterly with one another and some have turned on the government they helped install.
